date_note: Kyodo's report, dated 25 November, says the attack came early on 24 November.
geo_basis: the report places the company on New Zealand's South Island without naming a city; pin at the country's capital
title: New Zealand's Allied Media says a cyberattack disrupted newspaper systems and delayed delivery of local papers, Kyodo reports
summary: Kyodo reports that Allied Media, a South Island media company publishing daily and local newspapers, said it was hit by a cyberattack early on 24 November. Several newspaper systems malfunctioned, and delivery of at least three local papers due on 25 November was postponed to 26 November. The company said it shows no sign that customer information was leaked and is working to produce the 25 November editions of its dailies.
plain: Kyodo reports a cyberattack hit New Zealand's Allied Media, which publishes daily and local papers. Several systems failed and at least three local papers were delayed a day. The company says customer data shows no sign of a leak.
exec: Kyodo reports a cyberattack disrupted newspaper systems at Allied Media and delayed at least three local papers; the company says it sees no sign customer data leaked.
